ownership_reason: Only the gold decides the expanded length of the current segment: hops 1, 3 and 4 pass the segment or its length and the threshold along unchanged, hop 2 copies the characters into an array of the length it is given, and the facade stores and returns hop 1's array. The gold's javadoc promises the length to expand a segment to; for a segment that already has the threshold length the variant returns the same length, so the segment is not expanded, and no caller can obtain a longer array without replacing the gold's length or changing the threshold every hop documents. The convention (a segment past the threshold still grows) is pinned outside the gold: hop 2's javadoc ('a new, longer array'; past the threshold it grows 'to the threshold, or by a quarter of its length where that is more'); the intact overload TextBuffer.expandCurrentSegment(int) grows the segment to the requested size with no cap at MAX_SEGMENT_LEN; the production caller UTF8StreamJsonParser.addName writes a character at the old length right after expandCurrentSegment(), which needs a longer array; UTF8StreamJsonParser.growArrayBy always lengthens its array. testSimple (through the chain), testLongAppend (contents past MAX_SEGMENT_LEN are held) and TestUtf8Parser.testUtf8Name2Bytes (growArrayBy) pass.
